statement: The playable-monkey game is complete if and only if: one physically simulated monkey, in one finite forest clearing, supports the full player loop - walk on all fours, steer, stop, approach one rigid trunk, attach, climb, hold, descend, release, resume walking - with a usable camera and complete player flow; every one of the 76 selected items of the sealed 83-item map holds item-scoped integrated evidence; the integrated ground-tree-ground playthrough (K08) passes on the native runtime; and the operator explicitly accepts the actual play (S05). Nothing outside the sealed list gates completion.

rule0.statement: Completion is exactly the sealed 83-item map's selected 76 items with item-scoped integrated evidence, plus the integrated ground-tree-ground playthrough (K08) and explicit operator acceptance (S05); nothing else gates completion.
rule0.prediction: At freeze time no record establishes game completion: the integrated playthrough and operator acceptance remain open; freezing this contract changes no task acceptance status.
rule0.falsifier: Any completion claim lacking item-scoped evidence, the native-runtime playthrough record, or explicit operator acceptance is false; any identity below that cannot be recomputed from the actual records invalidates this contract.

success_conditions.clause: Ground movement: player-controlled all-fours walking that steers and stops, produced only through the approved physical actuation and learned skills on the declared terrain envelope.
One rigid climbable trunk: grip, support and release operate through the physical solver against the declared trunk asset; no invisible anchors or kinematic substitutes.

Return to ground: the complete ground-tree-ground loop - approach, attach, ascend, hold, descend, release, resume all-fours walking - succeeds in one session on the native runtime with explicit walk/climb arbitration and boundary/failure behavior.

terminal_done_when_verbatim.K08: Player approaches, attaches, ascends, holds, descends, releases and resumes all-fours walking in one session

success_conditions.clause: Explicit failure behavior: failures remain physical and visible (falls when support is lost, rejected out-of-reach grips, lost contact); no silent teleport, hidden support force or kinematic rescue; the player has an explicit way to continue from any failure state within the game flow.
Complete player flow and usable camera: launch, settings, pause/restart, persistence, camera follow and command mapping meet the frozen P06 limits and package identity matches the accepted game.
All selected core/product behaviors pass; remaining issues are triaged explicitly; the operator accepts actual play.

terminal_done_when_verbatim.S05: All selected core/product behaviors pass; remaining issues are triaged explicitly; operator accepts actual play

conditional_items.rule: Required only if the selected playable build actually consumes them; never auto-activated to fill slots; activation requires a lead scope amendment with operator authorization.

deferred_families: Multiple climbable tree forms and branch traversal
Jumping, swinging, brachiation, get-up and carrying
Water, weather, thermal and chemical interactions
Deformable trees, damage, tissue surgery and repair
Creator tools, UGC and collaborative authoring
Space, vehicles, economies and social systems
XR, haptics and advanced cognition/quantum research
forbidden_substitutes: Kinematic locomotion in place of physical actuation
Invisible support forces or hidden anchors in place of solver contact
Invented anatomy, constants, thresholds or supersessions without authorization
Percent-complete, calendar forecasts, reports, screenshots or PRs counted as completion
A merged diagnostic qualifying its parent gameplay task
exclusions.finish_line_verbatim: Playable monkey game first; broader Chimera vision later

acceptance_oracle.per_item: Each of the 76 selected items requires item-scoped integrated evidence matching its sealed verification profile (records/numerical/runtime/visual) at the reviewed exact head; a diagnostic or scaffold never qualifies its parent.
acceptance_oracle.integration: Integration checkpoints collect contributor evidence and never become prerequisites of their own contributors; the integrated playthrough (K08) and package identity (R07) are measured on the native runtime.
acceptance_oracle.human_terminal: The only final terminal is the operator's explicit acceptance of actual play (S05); no agent self-acceptance, no automatic completion, no synthetic pass.
acceptance_oracle.binding_rule: This contract binds completion semantics only; it cannot add, remove, weaken or reinterpret any sealed item, criterion or dependency.

amendments.purpose: P04 done_when correction (admitted training may interrupt gaming via verified supervisor handoff); operator-authorized
